home.intro: **Qualia Typo** is a participatory publishing project by the Qualia Art Youth Group that explores Athens through the experiences, observations and creative practices of the young people who live and are active in the city. Through regular meetings, participatory processes and an introduction to art history and creative methods, the group developed a shared line of inquiry: what is our place in this city?

about.title: About Qualia Typo
body: The four issues approach different sides of urban experience. **Qualia Typo #1**, built around the question **“Where is art?”**, looks for art within everyday life; **Qualia Typo #2**, otherwise known as **“on waiting”**, invites us to listen to the pauses and the in-between time of the city; **Qualia Typo #3**, **“on accessibility and visibility”**, asks who has access to, takes part in and becomes visible in its cultural and social life; and the last, **Qualia Typo #4**, synonymous with **“connection”**, explores what binds us to the places we live in and experience.

Beyond making the magazines, **Qualia Typo** was a process of active participation and collective learning. The people who took part shaped the course of the project together, made decisions that influenced how it developed, and built skills in shared responsibility, collaboration and the coexistence of different perspectives. Through this process, they redefined their relationship with the urban space of Athens, with inclusion and accessibility, and with effective intervention in the things that make our city feel unhomely.

Qualia Typo is a coffee table magazine, designed to be discovered in your own time. It is not a free press publication; it is an open invitation to pause for a while, leaf through its pages and wonder.

group.title: About us
body: The **Qualia Art Youth Group** is an informal youth group with an active network in Athens and Karditsa. It uses art education, art history and non-formal education as tools for learning, expression and active participation. It designs and carries out local and European activities that open up spaces for experimentation, collaboration and the exchange of different lived experiences, with a particular focus on the participation of young people with fewer opportunities.
